title: Errors (cloud)
description: Error groups from the log-based error counters, by the labels the catalogue allows: the service, the exception class, the operation or event, the code and the SQLSTATE. Nothing else.

panels.title: App tier: tpa-api, tpa-jobs, drains, model-gateway (app project)
Error groups in the time range (errors)
panels.description: Every error group of `errors` in the time range: the Cloud Run service or job, then the counter's labels, and its ERROR lines. A line carries an exception's class and never its message or a stack trace. A group new in the last hour (absent the 23 before) opens the `new error group` policy.

panels.title: ERROR lines, by service or job
panels.description: `errors` per interval. A group's hour above 5 times its 23-hour mean (and 10) opens the `error spike` policy.

panels.title: Crashes, out-of-memory kills, and secret or key versions taken away
App project
panels.description: Cloud Run containers that exited non-zero or by a signal other than SIGTERM and SIGKILL (`run_crash_exits`; `run-crash-loop`), killed for memory (`run_oom_kills`; `run-oom`), and a Secret Manager or KMS key version disabled or destroyed (Admin Activity audit log; `secret-version-disabled`, `kms-version-disabled` urgent): each breaks what reads it at its next deploy or restart. By the method alone; who and which stay in the entry.
